class.name: OcgShapefixEdgeconnect
class.brief_description: Rebuilds edges to connect with new vertices, was moved from ShapeBuild. Makes vertices to be shared to connect edges, updates positions and tolerances for shared vertices. Accepts edges bounded by two vertices each.

method.name: Add_2
method.description: Adds information on connectivity between start vertex of second edge and end vertex of first edge, taking edges orientation into account

method.name: Add_1
method.description: Adds connectivity information for the whole shape. Note: edges in wires must be well ordered Note: flag Closed should be set for closed wires

method.name: Build
method.description: Builds shared vertices, updates their positions and tolerances
